g_star_densification.note: Backlog #9.2: densifies the g* austerity floor to a 0.01 grid on the committed v6.8 run_fed, v16 storm + escrow E=6, both seeds, same build_params route as the sweep and the F2 isolation slices. Refines (not duplicates) v31's 0.05 grid and its (0.50,0.55] bracket.
g_star_densification.criterion: sustained breach = max_consec >= 3 (post-month-42), the program criterion

reconciliation_with_v31.note: 0.01-spaced floors reproduce v31's 0.50 and 0.55 cells exactly (same committed path/storm/E6), refining the sustained-breach edge from v31's (0.50,0.55] to (0.51,0.52] on the binding seed 11; full delivery (zero months below, both seeds) needs g >= 0.53. v31's >= 0.60 recommendation stands with ~8-9 hundredths of margin over the measured edge. max_consec and months_below are monotone in the floor (v31 AB1 holds on the finer grid); the p10 trough has a single <=0.011 non-monotone wiggle at 0.55->0.56 on seed 11, below the criterion and not a breach.

wtp_fail_tier_sensitivity.note: Backlog #9.3 / red-team A9: WTP is the program's single hinge; the registered field experiment sets FAIL bars an order of magnitude below the anchors. Here the three WTP anchors (data $600/contributor-yr, code $900, machine-pay $240/agent-yr) are divided jointly by 5 ($120-world) and 10 ($60-world, the A9 FAIL tier) and run through the committed v6.8 run_fed, J1-core peace + J2-core storm, both seeds. Reports which committed headlines break vs survive.

floor_delivery.claim: sponsor-funded essentials floor keeps delivering (0 months below, no printing)
floor_delivery.detail: floor delivery is sponsor-backed, not WTP-backed, so it holds at the $60-world in peace and storm, both seeds -- BUT the storm p10 trough thins to ~1.01 (from 1.06-1.09) and peace payr falls 0.85->0.69: the margin WTP was buying via slice/reserve bridging evaporates

floor_self_funding.claim: endogenous slice covers floor obligations (could wean off the sponsor)
floor_self_funding.detail: endogenous coverage (slice/obligations) is only ~0.13 peace / ~0.07 storm at anchor and roughly halves to ~0.07 / ~0.03 at the $60-world: the floor was never self-funding and the $60-world pushes any self-funding horizon 'years to the right' (A9), deepening sponsor dependence

sponsor_coverage.claim: sponsoring the floor stays cheaper than traditional welfare (ratio <= 0.85)
sponsor_coverage.detail: the member cost-per-enrollee vs traditional-welfare ratio is WTP-invariant (moves <0.01 from anchor to $60-world) because both the EDEN sponsor cost and the welfare benchmark scale with the same obligation; clears 0.85 in peace at every tier (~0.785) and sits ~0.87-0.91 in storm at every tier (a storm effect, not a WTP effect)

builder_viability.claim: builders earn a living (>= 20% of builders clear the $200/mo jobs line)
builder_viability.detail: median builder income collapses ~10x ($420->$45) and the share of builders clearing $200/mo falls from ~0.89 to ~0.02-0.03 at the $60-world -- the builder economy thins to non-viability, exactly the A9 prediction
